title: Glowing pear
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="60%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b8f06e" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#6ec53a" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3a7a1a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="pearBody" cx="45%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c8f77a"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#8ed94a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5aa82a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="pearHighlight" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="40%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e4ffb0" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b8f06e" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Outer glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="38" ry="42" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Pear main body -->
  <path d="M50 20 C42 20 36 28 36 36 C36 42 30 48 26 56 C20 68 28 82 50 82 C72 82 80 68 74 56 C70 48 64 42 64 36 C64 28 58 20 50 20Z" fill="url(#pearBody)"/>
  <!-- Highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="44" rx="10" ry="14" fill="url(#pearHighlight)"/>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d="M50 20 C50 14 52 8 56 6" stroke="#7a4a1a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Leaf -->
  <path d="M56 6 C62 2 72 4 74 10 C76 16 68 18 56 6Z" fill="#4ac84a"/>
  <path d="M56 6 C62 8 68 12 72 14" stroke="#2a8a2a" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Little leaf vein highlight -->
  <path d="M58 8 C63 10 67 12 70 14" stroke="#8ef08e" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
